name: Incident response
description: Record an incident in Notion with its timeline and follow-up actions, keep a copy in Google Drive, and alert the team.

fields.label: Incident title
fields.help: A short description, for example: Checkout page slow

fields.label: Severity
fields.help: How serious is it right now?

fields.label: Timeline and actions
fields.help: What happened, when, and what must be done next. Owners and due dates are picked up automatically.

example.timeline_and_actions:
09:10 Support reported slow checkout for some customers.
09:25 Sam found a database query taking too long.
09:40 Sam rolled back last night's change and speed recovered.
Follow-ups: Alex will write the incident summary by tomorrow. Priya will add an alert for slow queries this week.
